619-950-2645-3430.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

5254-5256-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5256-6774.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s)
Repeat.

4694-4802-5686-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a permanent that is boosting the toughness of all your creatures by at least 1, or that is giving a creature a +1/+1 counter as it enters the battlefield.
You control at least one additional creature.
4694-4802-5686-7306.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 1.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and will have its toughness boosted by the permanent specified in the pre-requisites to prevent it from dying.
Repeat.

222-527-3480-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3480-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1873-6758.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can attack this turn.
Fiendlash is attached to any creature you control
1873-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
1873-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  the creature with Fiendlash attached
Fiendlash triggers, dealing 100 damage to target opponent.

1874-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1874-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3641-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3641-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2334-4377-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Soulherder.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2469-5220-6273-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2469-5220-6273-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

430-2743-4365-6222.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-4365-6222.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Mondrak.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Emeritus of Ideation

1409-4067-7419.easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1409-4067-7419.description:
Activate Emeritus of Ideation by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
When Emeritus of Ideation enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Emeritus of Ideation.
Cast a copy of Ancestral Recall by paying {U}, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

240-5256-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-1669-3534.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-3534.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
250-779-1479-1669-3534.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3560-5147-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

339-647-677-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2498-3591-5014-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-3591-5014-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

2781-3306-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
2781-3306-4605.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-3861-5361.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

4094-4214-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4094-4214-5189-5439.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

880-2783-3875.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
If the creature was a Dragon Egg, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2011-3263-3598.notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One has a power of five or greater.
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2011-3263-3598.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Rapacious One.
Rapacious One triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate five Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {5}.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Rapacious One has power six or greater and/or a Warrior you control can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

3542-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}
3542-4499.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3542-4499.notes: If up to seven lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1439-1481-2034.notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
1439-1481-2034.description:
Cast Protean Raider by paying {1}{U}{R}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
When Protean Raider enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Protean Raider, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Protean Raider trigger, returning Protean Raider from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
Repeat from step 2.

1348-4249-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to green is at least five.
1348-4249-4657.description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra and preventing all damage done to, and dealt by, it this turn.
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Nykthos.
Repeat from step 2.

2-1283-1651-3459.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Battered Golem.
Resolve the Battered Golem trigger, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Battered Golem and Ancestral Statue, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, if you control a colored permanent, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

4096-4407-5167.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
4096-4407-5167.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Esper Sojourners and returning Unbender Tine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Esper Sojourners triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Unbender Tine by tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Unbender Tine and returning Esper Sojourners from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Unbender Tine trigger from step 3, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat.
